steps.name: Regional P.F. Commissioner (via EPFiGMS)
steps.when_to_use: For issues like claim rejections, KYC discrepancies, or delayed settlements

steps.name: Regional P.F. Commissioner (Nidhi Apke Nikat)
steps.when_to_use: If the online grievance remains unresolved

note: The EPFO grievance portal (EPFiGMS) is the primary channel for resolving KYC and name mismatch issues. Ensure you have your UAN and Aadhaar details ready for verification. The 'Nidhi Apke Nikat' program is an in-person grievance redressal initiative conducted by the EPFO.
